name: What is the typical process for sewage backup cleanup and restoration?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for sewage backup cleanup and restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically involves emergency water extraction, removal of contaminated materials like drywall and flooring, thorough cleaning and disinfection of affected areas, and drying using industrial-grade equipment. Once dry, reconstruction and repairs are performed. Air quality testing may also be conducted to ensure safety. Professionals ensure complete sanitization and restoration of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes water extraction, contaminated material removal, cleaning, disinfection, drying, and reconstruction. Air quality testing may also be done.
